name: Overbed table
notes: Height includes the patient's lidded cup and straw on the vanity section (top surface at 0.725 m).
parts: H-base of flat steel tube legs and crossbar
four 50 mm casters, two with brake pedals
rectangular telescoping column with gas spring
squeeze release lever under the top
fixed vanity section of the top
tilting reading panel with book-stop lip
PVC T-mold edge band around the laminate
room number label on the column
lidded water cup with bendy straw on the vanity section
style: Contemporary hospital overbed table (Invacare 6417 / Drive 13008 class), 76 x 38 cm top, 72-112 cm high; laminate worn at the near edge, scuffed caster housings.
summary: Hospital overbed table: H-base on four casters, gas-spring telescoping column, woodgrain laminate top with a tilting reading panel and vanity section.
